* * * * * We bring together dog owners and potential dog borrowers * * * * *

Sometimes, dog owners don’t have enough time to give their dogs the affection they deserve, but would love to give them more exciting lives.


There are also lots of folks who love dogs, but don’t have the time or inclination to own one.

* * * * * A win-win-win situation * * * * *

Everyone’s a winner with HAPPY PUPPY:

- DOGS:
Your new friend Silvia comes to visit on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and you love to get out for the extra run-around on these days.

- DOG BORROWERS:
Maybe your job is demanding, you live alone or you can’t take on the long-term obligations of dog ownership. But you still love dogs and the chance to take a dog out for a walk, or look after one for a while at home.

- DOG OWNERS:
Sometimes you don’t have enough time for your four-legged friend, but don’t like the idea – or prices – of paid dog sitters. HAPPY PUPPY users can find reliable dog borrowers for regular or occasional appointments, whenever they’re needed. They look forward to spending time with your dog, without any financial motivation. Some dog borrowers may be happy to look after your pet for longer periods, so you can even take a well-earned vacation.

* * * * * App functionality * * * * *

- Create a profile as a dog borrower or, if you’re a dog owner, create one for your dog
- Use a profile list or map to look for profiles in your area 
- Chat function as a means of establishing contact
- Social media timeline pictures and videos of dogs near you
- Post current inquiries if you need someone urgently for your dog, or if you’re a dog borrower who currently has the time and inclination to look after someone else’s dog.

* * * * * 250,000 users already registered * * * * *
